name: Jared Vox Editorial
summary: Turn a link or text into a narrated editorial film with archival paper, red marker accents and editable evidence cards.

compatibility.selects: Selects 2.0.512+ with plugin media generation, host FileSystem and bundled media runtime. No external runtime or provider key.
